execution_layout: API-materialized snapshots; no local git checkout; preserve all unrelated paths

scientific_contract.interpolation: nonnegative tensor-product linear hats in increasing mu=cos(theta) and E_eV
scientific_contract.azimuth_completion: explicit axisymmetric model around incident laboratory beam
scientific_contract.mass: m_e symbolic; report momentum scaled by sqrt(2 m_e epsilon) and tensor by 2 m_e epsilon
scientific_contract.sensitivity: exact extrema over positive cellwise deterministic box using quoted row percentages; no probability or coverage interpretation
scientific_contract.ratio_method: sort b/a and scan n+1 threshold vertices for each extremum; return extremizing witnesses
scientific_contract.alternative_model: one piecewise-linear-theta interpolation, integrated with sin(theta), identical source/window/energy interpolation
scientific_contract.claim_ceiling: measured-input conditional window moments under declared interpolation and nominated sensitivity box

implementation.language: Python 3 binary64 reference; this 32-cell operator has no measured HPC hot kernel
implementation.write_policy: atomic files; preserve all START/FINISH/FAIL logs and failed attempts; no silent overwrite of run IDs

acceptance.constant_and_affine_controls: independent closed-form integrations for r=0,1,2 and q=0,0.5,1 on a small domain
acceptance.independent_quadrature: cellwise Gauss-Legendre 16 and 32 points in each variable; independently evaluate local interpolation and weights
acceptance.ratio_extrema_oracle: exhaust all vertices for deterministic n<=6 controls; compare values and witnesses, including signed b and ties
physical_checks: common scale invariance of normalized box extrema
input_rejections: nonpositive ratio denominator weights or lower bounds
acceptance.figure: physical theta in degrees; no full-domain extrapolation; source units and window visible; quoted source errors and deterministic ratio-box ranges explicitly distinguished; readable at 180 mm; root visual review
acceptance.independent_C9: required before scoped scientific admission or science publication

resource_budget.authorization: current user requested next bounded research and coding loops; separate allocation, not transfer from previous unit
resource_budget.preexisting_unknown_cost: UNKNOWN_NOT_ZERO; preserved, not converted to zero or a complete grand total
resource_budget.stop: before launch if planned caps exceed remaining limits; after failure preserve evidence and return to root; no tolerance/model/budget change by executor; if observed cap overshoots record actual cost and stop
